Its exact 400 °C/1 h treatment, 10–30% phase fraction, Mg2Si identity, and assumed degradation are not established by the cited evidence—and E2 shows intermetallics can instead aid passivation—but these are testable weaknesses rather than A’s broader lack of specificity and evidentiary support.
